name: Control Room evidence provenance and claim supersession

allowedEvidence: provider receipts that already satisfy the Control Room allowlist

acceptanceCriteria: Equivalent JSON evidence produces one canonical SHA-256 digest regardless of object key order.
A claim is bound to source ID, source SHA-256, and observation SHA-256 before it can be superseded.
Mutated source bytes or observation content fail closed instead of silently reusing the old claim.
Supersession preserves historical evidence and emits a UUID-v4-compatible provenance receipt plus SHA-256 receipt digest.
Sanitized juss-proof/v1 receipts can explicitly reference prior receipt IDs through the existing supersedes string array without adding private fields.
The implementation never reads or exports teen, parent, journal, voice, Circle, private-message, credential, or raw-log content.

verification.note: Integrated on a review branch. Do not label verified or released until exact-head CI proves the branch and the reviewed content merges to main.

rollback: Revert the provenance integration commits. No database, Supabase, teen-runtime, parent-runtime, or production content migration is introduced.
